title: Heterogeneous outlier profiles and autorescale pipeline for LLama/Mistral/Qwen quant calibration
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Per-layer and per-head activation outliers in LLama, Mistral, and Qwen families cause INT8/FP8 quantization calibration to catastrophically degrade accuracy for some prompt distributions. Existing blanket layer-rescale fixes reduce global errors but miss headwise and sequence-length correlated spikes. Goal: Ship an automated pipeline that builds heterogeneous outlier profiles (per-model, per-layer, per-head, and per-sequence-length bucket), synthesizes per-layer rescale / clipping maps, and integrates a policy-driven fallback quantization path for production serving. Deliverables: 1) Data collection harness and probe suite to sample activations across diverse prompts and sequence lengths; 2) A resumable pipeline that synthesizes outlier-percentile maps and exports stable rescale artifacts; 3) Runtime policy to apply sample-aware rescale or fallback to higher-precision shards when thresholds are exceeded; 4) Validation dashboard and regression gates for model onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration pipeline produces deterministic per-layer and per-head rescale artifacts for LLama/Mistral/Qwen variants
INT8/FP8 quantized models using generated artifacts meet accuracy regressions < 0.5% on the developer eval suite compared to float baseline
Production heuristics trigger fallback to mixed-precision for <0.1% of live requests under traffic similar to internal beta
Artifacts are versioned and can be pinned during rollouts; rollout playbook documented
Automated regression checks run in CI and block model promotion on failures
implementation_notes: Phase 1: Probe harness - sample 50k in-distribution prompts and 20k long-tail prompts across length buckets (<=128, 129-512, 513-2048)
Phase 2: Per-head percentile profiling - compute 99.9/99.99/99.999 percentiles per layer/head and emit per-head scale factors and suggested clipping thresholds
Phase 3: Sequence-aware rescale - derive multiplicative rescale factors conditioned on sequence-length buckets to avoid overcompensation for short-context spikes
Phase 4: Artifact synthesizer - consolidate headwise maps into compact per-layer maps with fallback hints for runtime (use sparse encoding)

Phase 5: Runtime policy - add ability in serving runtime to read artifact meta and apply either (a) on-the-fly multiplicative rescale, (b) a short KV-cache bypass, or (c) fallback to mixed-precision shard; implement telemetry hooks for triggered fallbacks
Implementation constraints: maintain <3% added CPU overhead in the request path; ensure artifacts are <5MB per model version for fast distribution
Instrumentation: capture pre/post-quant token-level log-loss deltas, quantize-failure counters, and per-request fallback flags for the console dashboard
test_plan: Unit tests for probe sampling, percentile computation, and artifact serialization

Offline evaluation: compare quantized vs float across three corpora (dev prompts, long-tail user queries, synthetic stress prompts). Metrics: token-level cross-entropy, exact-match for structured outputs, and embedding cosine degradation for embedding models
A/B staging rollout: route 5% traffic to quantized+autorescale, 95% to current baseline; monitor latency, fallback rate, and accuracy regressions for 72h
Load test: ensure autoscaling and batching interact with autorescale logic without violating p95 latency SLOs
Regression gate: block merge if any model shows >0.5% drop in critical accuracy ops or fallback rate >0.5% under staging traffic
qa_results: Initial staging run on llama-2-70b: per-layer rescale artifacts reduced extreme head spikes; top-1 exact-match recovered from -1.8% regression to -0.2% against float baseline (dev prompts)
Mistral-7B early probe: sequence-length buckets revealed 512-2048 range had 3x more 99.999 percentile events; sequence-aware scaling reduced fallback triggers by 6x in offline sims
Qwen-14B: sparse artifact encoding kept artifact size to 3.2MB and added 1.7% CPU on median request in staging; p95 latency impact within SLO
Known failure: a few adversarial synthetic prompts still trigger fallback in >1% of cases; we introduced an adversarial blacklist for calibration samples and are iterating on clipping heuristics
